list.caption: Provisioning tokens
list.transferNoCap: Per-transfer limit: no cap below 20 GiB
list.lastUsedNote: The last use is recorded at most once a minute per token: it may lag behind by up to a minute.

form.title: Create a provisioning token
form.intro: The token can only be used from the allowed ranges and only creates entities whose address ends with an allowed suffix, within the caps below.

name.label: Name
name.hint: To recognise the token, for example the service provider it is given to.

cidrs.label: Allowed IP ranges
cidrs.hint: One range per line (CIDR). The ranges 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 are refused.

suffixes.label: Allowed FQDN suffixes
suffixes.hint: One suffix per line, starting with a dot, with at least two labels (.transfer.example.com).

maxTenants.label: Maximum number of entities
maxTenants.hint: Highest number of live entities created with this token.

quota.label: Highest storage quota per entity
quota.hint: No entity created with the token can get a larger quota.

transfer.label: Highest per-transfer limit (optional)
transfer.hint: Leave empty for no cap below 20 GiB.

expiry.label: Expiry date (optional)
expiry.hint: The token stops working at the end of this day. Leave empty for a token that never expires.

committed.value: Storage committed by this token: {size} (maximum number of entities times highest quota).
committed.unknown: Storage committed by this token: enter the number of entities and the quota to see it.
committed.large: Storage committed by this token: very large (more than can be shown exactly).
committed.note: This is the volume that could be allocated; check that your disk can host it.

form.confirm: To confirm, enter the current code of your authenticator app.
form.confirmRecovery: To confirm, enter one of your recovery codes. It can be used only once.

secret.title: Provisioning token {name} created
secret.text: Copy this token now and give it to the service provider through a trusted channel, never in clear by mail.
secret.label: Provisioning token

revoke.title: Revoke the token {name}?
revoke.text: The token stops working immediately. The entities it already created are kept. This cannot be undone.

errors.catchAll: A range that allows any address is refused.
errors.suffixDot: The suffix must start with a dot (.transfer.example.com).
errors.suffixInvalid: Enter a domain suffix with at least two labels (.transfer.example.com).
errors.maxTenants: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
